description: Saves in the local panel the report of what an agent did, shown under the agent among the agents in use. Call it when the agent finishes its task, before moving to another one. It stays on the user's computer.

summary.description: What the agent did, briefly: result, files touched, decisions taken or to take, open findings. At most 4000 characters.

name: report
title: Report of an agent for the panel
